_meta.title: Vibecode Town - Flux Kontext 2D Edit (Golden Reference -> Scene)
_meta.description: Flux Kontext image-to-image workflow for editing a golden reference of Vee into new scenes and poses while preserving character identity. Load a golden reference PNG, describe the desired edit, and generate.
_meta.author: vibecode-town pipeline

inputs.text: Change the character pose to sitting at a desk with a laptop, leaning forward with half-closed eyes in intense focus. Keep the same flat vector style, yellow hoodie, round black glasses, brown bob hair. Add a simple desk and laptop in matching flat vector style. White background.
